verdict.summary: Testing takes minutes; going public needs Google verification. Composio's defaults include full Drive access (restricted), which means a yearly third-party security assessment and about 6 weeks. Dropping the Drive scopes is your biggest lever.

cost.summary: Google charges nothing for verification. With restricted scopes you pay a Google-approved third-party assessor for the annual security assessment; the price isn't published by Google.

firstConnection.definition: You (or up to 100 listed test users) connect a Google account through Composio while the app is in Testing.
firstConnection.summary: Same-day, but test users' authorizations expire after 7 days, so expect to reconnect weekly while testing.

production.definition: Any Google user can connect without the 'unverified app' warning or the 100-user cap.
production.summary: With default scopes: restricted-scope verification (Google estimates 6 weeks) plus a security assessment. Without the full Drive scopes, sensitive-scope verification (about 10 business days) plus brand verification (2–3 business days).

stages.name: Get a first working connection (Testing)
stages.unlocks: Up to 100 listed test users can connect; authorizations last 7 days.

steps.title: Create a Google Cloud project and enable the Forms API
steps.instructions: In Google Cloud Console, create a project and enable the Google Forms API (and the Drive API if you keep Drive scopes).
steps.whyHuman: Needs your Google account and acceptance of Google Cloud terms.

steps.title: Configure the OAuth consent screen (Branding, Audience, Data Access)
steps.instructions: Pick the audience: Internal if only your own Workspace org will connect (no verification needed), otherwise External. Leave publishing status as Testing and add yourself as a test user. Under Data Access, add only the scopes you need; the console groups them as non-sensitive, sensitive and restricted.
steps.agentHelp: The agent lists Composio's six default scopes, marks which are restricted, and proposes a trimmed set.

steps.title: Create a Web application OAuth client
steps.instructions: Create an OAuth client ID of type Web application and add Composio's redirect URI as an authorized redirect URI. Copy the client ID and secret into a Composio custom auth config, with the trimmed scopes.
steps.whyHuman: The secret is created in your Google account.

steps.title: Connect a test user and make a test call
steps.instructions: Connect via a Composio Connect Link. You'll see an 'unverified app' warning, which is expected in Testing. Then run a read tool (for example, get a form).

stages.name: Get verified for public use
stages.unlocks: Any Google user can connect; no 100-user cap, no 7-day expiry.

steps.title: Prepare brand verification
steps.instructions: Publish a homepage and a privacy policy on a domain you own, verify that domain in Search Console, and fill in the app name and logo.
steps.agentHelp: The agent drafts a privacy policy section on Google user data and checks that your URLs resolve on the authorized domain.
steps.whyHuman: Domain ownership and the legal text are yours.

steps.title: Submit for verification with a scope justification
steps.instructions: Switch to In production and submit. For each sensitive or restricted scope, explain why a narrower one won't do. Google may ask for a demo video showing the consent flow and how the data is used.
steps.agentHelp: The agent drafts the per-scope justifications and a demo-video script.
steps.whyHuman: You submit as the app owner and answer Google's reviewers.

steps.title: Pass the CASA security assessment (restricted scopes only)
steps.instructions: If you keep drive or drive.readonly, a Google-empanelled assessor checks your app against the CASA framework. Repeat at least every 12 months.
steps.whyHuman: You contract with and work alongside the assessor.

requirements.description: A Google Cloud project with the Forms API enabled.

limits.appliesWhen: Sensitive or restricted scopes, not yet verified

gotchas.symptom: Connections fail with invalid_grant about a week after users connect.
gotchas.cause: In Testing, test users' authorizations expire 7 days after consent.
gotchas.fix: Reconnect, or move to In production (which triggers verification for sensitive and restricted scopes).

gotchas.symptom: New users see 'Sign in with Google temporarily disabled for this app'.
gotchas.cause: The unverified app used up its 100-new-user cap.
gotchas.fix: Finish verification. Plan for it before launch, not after.

gotchas.symptom: Your verified app suddenly shows the unverified warning again.
gotchas.cause: You added a sensitive or restricted scope that wasn't part of the verified set.
gotchas.fix: Submit the new scope for verification before shipping it (and reassessment if it's restricted).

scopeNotes.note: Full Drive access. This is what triggers the security assessment. Remove it unless your agent truly needs every file.
Also restricted. Remove it for the same reason.
Only files the user opens or creates with your app. Google's recommended, non-sensitive choice.
Reported as sensitive by third parties: verification is still needed, but no security assessment. Confirm in the console's Data Access page.

claims.text: Google's expected verification times are 2–3 business days for brand verification, 10 business days for sensitive scopes, and 6 weeks for restricted scopes (which add a security assessment). Brand verification checks the logo, display name, URLs and domain ownership.

claims.text: Unverified apps using sensitive or restricted scopes have a 100-new-user cap; when it's used up, Google sign-in is disabled for the app.

sources.quote: Failure to get your app verified before making requests to sensitive or restricted scopes will result in your project's 100 new-user cap eventually getting exhausted and Google sign-in being disabled for your users.

openQuestions.question: Do Composio's Google Forms tools still work if the Drive scopes are reduced to drive.file only?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: If yes, production drops from ~6 weeks plus an annual paid assessment to ~10 business days with no assessment.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Connect with only the Forms scopes plus drive.file and run each Forms tool.

openQuestions.question: Does the console classify the Forms scopes as sensitive?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: It confirms the sensitive (10-day) path and moves the claim from third-party to tested.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Add the scopes on the Data Access page and note which section they land in.

openQuestions.question: What does a CASA assessment typically cost?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: It's the main cash cost of keeping restricted scopes.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Check the App Defense Alliance assessor list and published quotes.

corrections.before: Google Forms production takes about 6 weeks.
corrections.after: About 6 weeks only with Composio's default Drive scopes (restricted). Trimming them makes it sensitive-scope verification, about 10 business days.
corrections.why: The step-1 shortlist treated the default scope set as fixed. The guide now separates the default path from the trimmed path.
